heading: Report illegal content
intro: Anyone can use this form, with or without an account. Tell us where the content is and why you think it breaks the law. A person on our team reads every report.
contactPoint: This form is our contact point for authorities, including for removal orders under Regulation (EU) 2021/784. We accept reports and orders in English and Romanian, and we act on removal orders within one hour.

form.heading: Your report
form.kind: What kind of content is it?
form.contentUrlHint: Copy it from your browser’s address bar.
form.explanation: Why do you think it’s illegal?
form.explanationHint: Explain in your own words. If it copies your work, say which work and where it was first published.
form.name: Your name
form.contactHint: We send a receipt to this address, and later our decision.
form.contactOptionalHint: For this kind of report you may leave your name and email out. Without an email we can’t send you a receipt or our decision.
form.goodFaith: I believe, in good faith, that the information in this report is accurate and complete.

problems.kind_missing: Choose what kind of content it is.
problems.url_missing: Paste the exact link to the content.
problems.explanation_missing: Say why you think it’s illegal.
problems.email_invalid: Write an email address we can reply to, like name@example.com.
problems.good_faith_missing: Tick the good-faith statement to send the report.
problems.authority_missing: Write the name of the authority sending the order.

order.heading: Removal order
order.intro: For competent authorities sending a removal order under Regulation (EU) 2021/784. The order reaches the person on call at once, and we act within one hour of receipt.
order.orderText: The order, or a summary of it
order.orderTextHint: Paste the order’s text, or summarise it and say where it can be read.
order.emailHint: We confirm receipt, with the time, at once.

failures.invalid: Something in the report isn’t right. Check the fields and try again.
failures.unavailable: We couldn’t save the report just now. Try again in a minute, or email {{supportEmail}}.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

received.heading: Report received
received.body: Your reference is {{reference}}. We received it on {{time}}.
received.emailed: We’ve sent a receipt to {{email}}. A person will read your report, and we’ll email you our decision.
received.noEmail: A person will read your report. You didn’t give an email, so we can’t write back.
received.unsent: We saved your report, but we couldn’t send the receipt. Keep the reference above.
received.orderBody: Our reference is {{reference}}. Time of receipt: {{time}} (Romania time). The person on call has been alerted.

steps.receipt: We email you a receipt with a reference number.
steps.check: A person on our team checks the content against the law and our rules.
steps.decision: We email you our decision and how to ask us to look again.

account.heading: Have an account?
account.body: Log in and use the Report button on the story, chapter or profile. It fills in the link for you.

details.heading: Your details
details.body: We use your name and email only to handle this report. We keep them for 3 years after your report is closed, then delete them.
